from pwn import *

binary = './zone'
p = process(binary)

def try_inputs():
    # Helper function to interact with menu
    # Get initial menu
    out = p.recvuntil(b'Exit', timeout=1)
    print(out.decode())
    # Press Enter
    p.sendline(b'')
    out = p.recvuntil(b'Exit', timeout=1)
    print('After Enter:', out.decode())

    # Try simple input (e.g., pick menu option 1)
    p.sendline(b'1')
    out = p.recvuntil(b'Exit', timeout=1)
    print('After option 1:', out.decode())
    # Try option 3 (write to last block)
    p.sendline(b'3')
    out = p.recvuntil(b':', timeout=1)
    print('Write prompt:', out.decode())

    # Try number (e.g., 12345) as input
    p.sendline(b'12345')
    out = p.recvuntil(b'Exit', timeout=1)
    print('After input 12345:', out.decode())

    # Try long string
    p.sendline(b'3')
    out = p.recvuntil(b':', timeout=1)
    p.sendline(b'A'*100)
    out = p.recvuntil(b'Exit', timeout=1)
    print('After 100 A:', out.decode())

    # Try format string
    p.sendline(b'3')
    out = p.recvuntil(b':', timeout=1)
    p.sendline(b'%x %x %x')
    out = p.recvuntil(b'Exit', timeout=1)
    print('After format string:', out.decode())

    # Try format string %p
    p.sendline(b'3')
    out = p.recvuntil(b':', timeout=1)
    p.sendline(b'%p %p %p')
    out = p.recvuntil(b'Exit', timeout=1)
    print('After %p:', out.decode())

    # Try non-alphanumeric input
    p.sendline(b'3')
    out = p.recvuntil(b':', timeout=1)
    p.sendline(b';ls;/bin/sh')
    out = p.recvuntil(b'Exit', timeout=1)
    print('After shellish input:', out.decode())

    # Try menu structure, options, buffer size
    p.sendline(b'4')  # Print last block
    out = p.recvuntil(b'Exit', timeout=1)
    print('Print last block:', out.decode())
    
    # Cleanly exit
    p.sendline(b'5')
    print('Process exited with code', p.poll())

try_inputs()
